Title: A new version of Text Analytics is now in public preview

Body.Content:
Text Analytics is now enabling asynchronous (or batch processing) scenarios. Additionally, you can extract key phrases, named entity recognition, and PII recognition all within one API call, instead of multiple API calls. Finally, we've added trained models to support health specific language and scenarios.

Learn More
